# Introducing Terra

Published

May 31, 2023

Reshaping small form factor gaming

Meet Fractal Terra — a PC case designed and engineered to reshape the small form factor gaming experience.

Inspired by the homes of modern gamers, Terra has been crafted to lift the desk environment and harmonize powerful gaming technology into their living space. To achieve this, it incorporates boutique design features such as panels cut from anodized aluminum, including an 8 mm-thick aluminum front and a panel made from FSC-certified solid walnut.

From building through to daily use, Terra was designed with user interaction in mind. Whether someone rotates open the aluminum side panels, slides open the top with the integrated tab or presses the laser-engraved aluminum power button — every interaction with Terra is designed to feel smooth and enjoyable.

Inside, Terra hides smart features such as a stepless slidable central wall, allowing users to adapt the space ratio between compartments by up to 30 mm. This gives builders the freedom to design their small form factor gaming PC around their component choices, including the option to incorporate a large GPU in a space-saving 10.4 L case.

Terra is out now – check with your favorite retailer about availability

Overview

 

## Fractal Design Terra : Elegant and spacious mini-tower case

The Fractal Design Terra is a PC case in mini-tower format that is both aesthetically pleasing and functional. Terra incorporates innovative design features such as thick panels cut from anodised aluminium and FSC-certified solid walnut. Inside, it includes a PCIe 4.0 riser cable and has a continuously sliding centre wall for construction flexibility, offering space for a graphics card up to 322 mm long.

## Key features

- Install a powerful GPU up to 322 mm long, in a space-saving 10.4 L case.
- Front panel cut from FSC-certified solid walnut.
- Enjoy an elegant anodised aluminium case with an 8 mm thick front panel.
- Find the ideal balance in your construction with 30 mm of internal flexibility provided by a sliding centre panel.
- Front panel I/O with aluminium power button and two USB ports, including USB-C 3.2 20 Gbit/s.
- Vertical graphics card installation with PCIe 4.0 16x Riser included.
- Up to two SSDs in dedicated 2.5" drive mounts
- Rotate side panels or slide top with integrated tab for easy access.
- Make the most of natural airflow through the ventilated top, side and bottom panels.
- Transport your finished construction safely with lockable top and side panels.
